component.name: CommandPalette
component.description: CommandPalette is a component for displaying a searchable list of commands or options, optionally grouped into categories. It supports nested groups, keyboard navigation, and customizable rendering through slots and styles.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Command palette container that owns search, navigation stack, and option list.

slots.name: inputWrapper
slots.description: Search row that groups input, search icon, and navigation controls.

slots.name: input
slots.description: Search input used to filter commands.

slots.name: listbox
slots.description: Scrollable command list that owns option and active-descendant semantics.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Bottom region for keyboard hints or custom footer content.

slots.name: group
slots.description: Section wrapper for a group of command items.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Group heading text.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Command row that can be highlighted, selected, or disabled.

slots.name: itemLeading
slots.description: Leading icon or visual for a command row.

slots.name: itemWrapper
slots.description: Text column that groups command label and description.

slots.name: itemLabel
slots.description: Primary text for a command item.

slots.name: itemLabelBase
slots.description: Base text region for an item label before prefix or suffix decoration.

slots.name: itemLabelPrefix
slots.description: Prefix text rendered before the main item label.

slots.name: itemLabelSuffix
slots.description: Suffix text rendered after the main item label.

slots.name: itemDescription
slots.description: Supporting text for a command item.

slots.name: itemTrailing
slots.description: Trailing region for shortcuts, submenu indicators, or custom item metadata.

slots.name: itemTrailingKbds
slots.description: Container for keyboard shortcut hints at the end of a command row.

slots.name: itemTrailingKbd
slots.description: Individual keyboard key hint in a command row.

slots.name: search
slots.description: Search icon or loading indicator displayed in the input row.

slots.name: back
slots.description: Button that returns from a nested command group.

slots.name: close
slots.description: Button that dismisses the command palette.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Message shown when no command items match the search.

props.name: label
props.description: Display name for the group header.

own.name: autofocus
own.description: Whether to focus the search input automatically on mount.

own.name: backIcon
own.description: Icon name for the group navigation back button.

own.name: childIcon
own.description: Icon name for items with sub-groups.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: close
own.description: Whether to show a close button in the header.

own.name: closeIcon
own.description: Icon name for the palette close button.

own.name: emptyRender
own.description: Elements to show when no items match the search.

own.name: footerRender
own.description: Content to render at bottom of the palette.

own.name: loading
own.description: Whether the palette is in a loading state.

own.name: loadingIcon
own.description: Icon name for the loading state.

own.name: onClose
own.description: Callback triggered when the close button is clicked.

own.name: onSearchTermChange
own.description: Callback triggered when the search term changes.

own.name: placeholder
own.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

own.name: searchIcon
own.description: Icon name for the search indicator.

own.name: searchMaxLength
own.description: Maximum allowed length for the search text.
